sentences.text: Shri Romil Malpani, learned counsel for the appellants  Issue notice to the respondents on payment of process  seven working days by RAD mode.
Notices be made returnable within four weeks.
Record of the Claims Tribunal be called for.
In addition, Registry is directed to instruct the concerned MACT to scan the entire record of the case before sending the same to this Court and to upload it as per the procedure prescribed.

Also heard on I.A.No.10779/2025, an application for staying execution of the impugned award.
Learned counsel for the appellants submits that in fact it is a case where driver of the insured vehicle i.e. Tata Magic helped the injured person/claimant and taken him to Saifee Hospital, after getting him there the driver left with his vehicle.
However, the injured has falsely implicated the insured vehicle to get the compensation.

He refers to findings recorded by the claims Tribunal in para 17 and 19 of the impugned award and submits that it was mentioned in the treatment papers that accident caused due to "fall for bike" and below that it was also mentioned that "hit by another bike".
In both circumstances the involvement of the insured vehicle cannot be proved as the insured vehicle is a Tata Magic four wheeler.
Considering the submissions and the provisions of Section 134 of Motor Vehicles Act, where duty of driver is prescribed the execution of the impugned award shall remain stayed.
List this case after four weeks.
(PAVAN KUMAR DWIVEDI) JUDGE patil Sanjay Jain vs Devilal @ Gattu on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131038836/
